answer: One concrete mechanism: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because willow only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, atlas is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
